src='''def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    boxes=[]
    for r1 in range(h):
        for c1 in range(w):
            c=g[r1][c1]
            for r2 in range(r1+2,h):
                if g[r2][c1]!=c: break
                for c2 in range(c1+2,w):
                    if g[r1][c2]!=c: break
                    if g[r2][c2]!=c: continue
                    ok=all(g[r1][x]==c and g[r2][x]==c for x in range(c1,c2+1))
                    ok=ok and all(g[y][c1]==c and g[y][c2]==c for y in range(r1,r2+1))
                    if not ok: continue
                    interior={(y,x) for y in range(r1+1,r2) for x in range(c1+1,c2)}
                    vals={g[y][x] for y,x in interior}
                    if len(vals)==1 and vals.pop()!=c:
                        boxes.append((interior,))
    seen=set()
    for (interior,) in boxes:
        if interior & seen: continue
        seen|=interior
        fill=2 if len(interior)%2==0 else 7
        for y,x in interior: out[y][x]=fill
    return out
'''
